## List enterprise pattern configurations

`GET /enterprises/{enterprise}/secret-scanning/pattern-configurations`

Lists the secret scanning pattern configurations for an enterprise.

Personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:enterprise` scope to use this endpoint.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `enterprise` | path | `string` | Yes | The slug version of the enterprise name. |

### HTTP Response Status Codes

| Status Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `200` | OK |
| `403` | Forbidden |
| `404` | Resource not found |

## Update enterprise pattern configurations

`PATCH /enterprises/{enterprise}/secret-scanning/pattern-configurations`

Updates the secret scanning pattern configurations for an enterprise.

Personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:enterprise` scope to use this endpoint.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `enterprise` | path | `string` | Yes | The slug version of the enterprise name. |

### Body Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `pattern_config_version` | `string or null` | No | The version of the entity. This is used to confirm you're updating the current version of the entity and mitigate unintentionally overriding someone else's update. |
| `provider_pattern_settings` | `array of objects` | No | Pattern settings for provider patterns. |
| `custom_pattern_settings` | `array of objects` | No | Pattern settings for custom patterns. |

### HTTP Response Status Codes

| Status Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `200` | OK |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |
| `404` | Resource not found |
| `409` | Conflict |
| `422` | Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed. |

## List organization pattern configurations

`GET /orgs/{org}/secret-scanning/pattern-configurations`

Lists the secret scanning pattern configurations for an organization.

Personal access tokens (classic) need the `read:org` scope to use this endpoint.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `org` | path | `string` | Yes | The organization name. The name is not case sensitive. |

### HTTP Response Status Codes

| Status Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `200` | OK |
| `403` | Forbidden |
| `404` | Resource not found |
